learned.en: Name what three share.
The fourth then stands out.
Do not start from how one looks.
Check that your group fits exactly three.

text.en: The answer is defined by the other three. Name their group.
text.as: উত্তৰ বাকী তিনিটাৰ দ্বাৰা ঠিক হয়। সিহঁতৰ গোটৰ নাম কোৱা।

text.en: Most word groups come from everyday life.

s.en: In odd one out, start by finding what three share.
s.as: বেলেগটো উলিয়াবলৈ তিনিটাৰ উমৈহতীয়া গুণৰ পৰা আৰম্ভ কৰা।

why.en: The group defines the odd one.
Look for what the other three share, not how one looks.

learned.en: All four may look alike.

Try a second property if the first fails.

text.en: If four things seem one family, ask how they work.

text.en: Ask about use, material, place and life.

learned.en: Test odd and even first.
Then primes, squares and cubes.
Then multiples of one number.
Digit sums can be the link.

text.en: Run the same quick checks every time.
23, 41, 50 all have digits adding to 5. 62 does not.

why.en: The others have digits adding to 5.

learned.en: Vowels and consonants are the first split.

text.en: If only one option holds a vowel, or lacks one, that is the rule.
